title: Handling session management request for UE configured for dual priority

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer that runs when session management requests with low priority indicator are rejected due to insufficient resources.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to request PDN connectivity, can include low priority indicator.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to modify bearer resources, can include low priority indicator.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to allocate bearer resources, can include low priority indicator.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message used to deactivate EPS bearer context, can include timer T3396 and ESM cause #26.

entities.name: Low priority indicator
entities.description: Information element indicating whether MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority or not.

entities.name: Timer T3396 running
entities.description: Condition where timer T3396 is active due to rejection of low priority requests with insufficient resources.

entities.name: Upper layer request
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request the UE to send session management messages.

entities.name: Send messages without low priority
entities.description: UE behavior to send session management messages with low priority indicator set to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority' when T3396 is running.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when T3396 is running for certain conditions, with low priority indicator set to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

relations.description: Timer T3396 running condition guards the UE behavior for session management requests.
Upper layer request establishes UE behavior to send messages without low priority indicator.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains the low priority indicator IE.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains the low priority indicator IE.
BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message contains the low priority indicator IE.
Attach procedure includes sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
Send without low priority property is guarded by setting low priority indicator to 'MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority'.
